summary: Read-only review accepted the demo/runner checks with one nonblocking note. Fresh setup paths align: the README uses the repo-root runner, which calls the existing interaction runner, bundles the pinned React packages, then runs replacement tests, demo smoke, and parity. CI provisions Go 1.24, Node 22, dependencies, and Chromium. The demo keeps no JS counter state and its deferred click refresh runs after React delegated dispatch/flush; the seven-state browser smoke checks Go Count/messages, actual DOM, HTML equality, and disabled paths. Nonblocking note: the interactive demo does not surface a caught React callback error from a native click because its deferred refresh clears the banner without reading backend lastError; this is outside the requested happy-path check.
